changeReason: The v2.0 pre-score run timed out after 30/50 cases when MiniMax-M3 used provider-default thinking on a 45-criterion batch. V2.1 disables thinking for both judges, changes no sample, prompt, aggregation, metric, or gate, and reruns all 50 cases in a fresh output directory.

aggregation.primary: equal-weight mean of per-judge, per-case MPA, FAA, FAMA, and criterion accuracy
aggregation.twoJudgeDisagreement: no tiebreaker; report exact vote agreement and both judge-specific effects
aggregation.sensitivity: unanimous verdict; a disagreement, duplicate, missing, or non-binary vote is unclear and incorrect
